name: NeuroKit2
runtime_deps: numpy>=2.0 (0.2.13), pandas<3, scipy, scikit-learn, matplotlib, PyWavelets; optional ts2vg (emrich2023 detector), pyrqa (complexity_rqa method='pyrqa')
method: ecg_clean (8 filter recipes) -> ecg_peaks (16 R-peak detectors incl. ProMAC consensus, optional Lipponen-Tarvainen artifact correction) -> ecg_delineate (peak/derivative, CWT, DWT, peak-prominence [Emrich 2024]) -> ecg_phase, ecg_quality, signal_rate; HRV time / frequency / nonlinear / RQA from R-peaks or RR intervals
signal_types: ECG; PPG; RSP; EDA; EMG; EOG; EEG
shape: 1-D list / np.ndarray / pd.Series (n_samples,) for ECG functions; HRV functions take R-peak sample indices, the ecg_peaks info dict / signals DataFrame, or a dict with 'RRI' (ms) and 'RRI_Time' (s)
fs_supported: any (user supplied); no hard check except khamis2016 (raises if < 50 Hz)
fs_notes: Every function defaults to sampling_rate=1000, so it must always be passed explicitly. ecg_clean: 'neurokit' = 0.5 Hz high-pass Butterworth (order 5) + powerline moving-average filter (powerline=50 default; kernel int(fs/50) samples if fs>=100, else 2); 'biosppy' = FIR band-pass 0.67-45 Hz with 1.5*fs taps (filtfilt); 'pantompkins1985' 5-15 Hz, 'hamilton2002' 8-16 Hz, 'elgendi2010' 8-20 Hz Butterworth band-pass; 'engzeemod2012' 48-52 Hz band-stop; 'vg'/'emrich2023' 4 Hz high-pass; christov2004 / ssf / zong2003 / kalidas2017 do no cleaning. signal_filter only *warns* (NeuroKitWarning) when fs <= 2*cutoff, it does not raise. Detector-specific: khamis2016 raises Exception for fs < 50 Hz and uses 0.7 Hz HP / 20 Hz LP order-7 Butterworth; zong2003 needs >= 10*fs samples (10 s) else warns and returns no peaks; manikandan2012 uses a 2.5 s moving average (comment cites 360 Hz/500 Hz originals); rodrigues2021 threshold Pth = 0.7*fs/128 + 2.7 (comment: Pth=3 optimal for fs=250); kalidas2017 SWT db3 level 3 + 0.01-10 Hz band-pass; emrich2023 needs the ts2vg package, 2 s windows. ecg_delineate method='dwt' internally resamples the cleaned signal to analysis_sampling_rate=2000 Hz and maps points back; its search parameters scale with (fs/250)/(HR/60). method='cwt' uses fixed pywt CWT scales [1,2,4,8,16] ('gaus1') regardless of fs, with 0.1*fs half-wave search windows. method='prominence' converts ms limits (max_qrs_interval=180, max_pr_interval=300, max_r_rise_time=120, typical_st_segment=150, P/R/T basepoint 100/100/200 ms) to samples using fs. ecg_quality zhao2018 uses Welch bands up to 40 Hz (pSQI 5-15/5-40 Hz, basSQI 0-1/0-40 Hz, window=1024) so fs > 80 Hz is implied. hrv_frequency interpolates RR at interpolation_rate=100 Hz (independent of ECG fs). 0.2.13 changelog: some ecg_peaks methods now accept float fs (#1153).
amplitude_units: unit-agnostic (no mV thresholds in ECG cleaning/detection/delineation; relative thresholds only)
preprocessing: ecg_clean (see fs_notes) with NaN forward-fill (0.2.12) / signal_fillmissing (0.2.13); ecg_process = ecg_clean -> ecg_peaks(correct_artifacts=True) -> signal_rate -> ecg_quality -> ecg_delineate (default dwt) -> ecg_phase; ecg_peaks optional Kubios-style artifact correction (signal_fixpeaks, Lipponen & Tarvainen 2019); nk.ecg_invert for inverted signals
output_format: pandas DataFrame (per-sample columns with 0/1 event markers, or one-row feature tables) + dict of sample indices
features: beat_segments; edr; heart_rate; hrv_apen; hrv_asymmetry; hrv_csi_cvi; hrv_cvnn; hrv_dfa; hrv_geometric; hrv_hf; hrv_hr_stats; hrv_lf; hrv_lf_hf; hrv_lfnu_hfnu; hrv_meannn; hrv_median_iqr; hrv_other_entropy; hrv_pnn20; hrv_pnn50; hrv_poincare; hrv_rmssd; hrv_rqa; hrv_sampen; hrv_sdann; hrv_sdnn; hrv_sdsd; hrv_total_power; hrv_ulf_vhf; hrv_vlf; p_offset; p_onset; p_peak; q_peak; qrs_offset; qrs_onset; r_peak; s_peak; sqi_classification; sqi_other; sqi_template_corr; t_offset; t_onset; t_peak

name: BioSPPy
runtime_deps: numpy, scipy, matplotlib, scikit-learn, h5py, bidict, shortuuid, six, joblib, opencv-python, pywavelets, mock; peakutils (imported by signals/ecg.py but missing from the 2.2.4 wheel metadata)
method: Fixed FIR band-pass (0.67-45 Hz) -> R-peak segmenter (Hamilton default; ASI, Gamboa, Engelse-Zeelenberg, SSF, Pan-Tompkins++; Christov callable directly) -> R-peak correction to local max (+-50 ms) -> heartbeat templates (-0.2..+0.4 s) -> rule-based P/Q/S/T positions from local extrema of each template; separate HRV module and SQIs
signal_types: ECG; PPG; BVP; ABP; EDA; EMG; EEG; RESP; PCG; ACC
shape: 1-D array (n_samples,); getP/Q/S/TPositions take the ReturnTuple produced by biosppy.signals.ecg.ecg(); hrv() takes rpeaks (indices) or rri (ms)
fs_param: sampling_rate (ecg(), segmenters, hrv); fs (bSQI, fSQI, ZZ2018)
fs_supported: any > 90 Hz for ecg() (45 Hz FIR cut-off must be below Nyquist)
fs_notes: ecg() FIR band-pass [0.67, 45] Hz with order int(1.5*fs) (forced odd) via scipy firwin + filtfilt; firwin rejects cut-offs >= Nyquist, so fs must exceed 90 Hz. hamilton_segmenter adds 4th-order Butterworth LP 25 Hz + HP 3 Hz and uses an 8 s initialisation (shortened to the signal duration if shorter). Pan_Tompkins_Plus_Plus special-cases fs == 200 (5-12 Hz) but that branch calls signal.butter on the numpy input array (name shadowing) and will raise AttributeError; other fs use a 5-18 Hz 3rd-order Butterworth and a derivative kernel interpolated by 160/fs. ASI_segmenter uses N = round(3*fs/128) with fixed Pth=5. SSF uses an absolute threshold=20 (amplitude dependent). engzee threshold=0.48. All windows are expressed in seconds and converted with fs; no internal resampling. Module docstring: 'Implemented code assumes a single-channel Lead I like ECG signal.' get_heart_rate discards HR outside 40-200 bpm.
amplitude_units: mostly unit-agnostic; ssf_segmenter threshold=20 and pSQI f_thr=0.01 'mV / sample' are absolute; ZZ2018 docstring expects mV
preprocessing: ecg(): FIR 0.67-45 Hz band-pass + DC removal, R-peak correction (argmax within +-0.05 s), smoothed HR; hrv(): RR outlier interpolation (rri_correction, threshold 250 ms) by default and smoothness-priors detrending (detrend_rri=True); frequency domain cubic-interpolates RR at 4 Hz
output_format: biosppy.utils.ReturnTuple (named tuple of numpy arrays / scalars); SQIs are floats or strings
features: beat_segments; generic_fractal; generic_spectral; generic_statistical; generic_temporal; heart_rate; hrv_apen; hrv_geometric; hrv_hf; hrv_hr_stats; hrv_lf; hrv_lf_hf; hrv_lfnu_hfnu; hrv_meannn; hrv_median_iqr; hrv_nn50; hrv_peak_freq; hrv_pnn50; hrv_poincare; hrv_rmssd; hrv_sampen; hrv_sdnn; hrv_ulf_vhf; hrv_vlf; p_offset; p_onset; p_peak; q_peak; qrs_offset; qrs_onset; r_peak; s_peak; sqi_classification; sqi_detector_agreement; sqi_flatline_clipping; sqi_kurtosis; sqi_other; sqi_power_ratio; sqi_skewness; t_offset; t_onset; t_peak

name: prominence-delineator
runtime_deps: numpy, scipy; optional vg-beat-detectors (FastNVG R peaks), neurokit2 (cleaning)
method: Beat-wise segmentation around user/FastNVG R peaks (half RR each side); local extrema weighted by peak prominence select Q, S, P, T; on/offsets from prominence base points constrained by physiological windows (max R rise 0.12 s, typical ST 0.15 s, max PR 0.3 s, max QRS 0.18 s). Optional multi-lead correction (tol 0.15 s, 2/3 / 1/3 lead agreement).
shape: find_waves: 1-D ndarray (n_samples,) + R-peak index array; find_waves_multilead: Python list of 1-D arrays (one per lead) + list of R-peak arrays (an ndarray container is rejected by an isinstance(list) check although the README says 'list or ndarray')
fs_supported: any positive value (user supplied; ValueError if <= 0)
fs_notes: All physiological windows are given in seconds and converted with int(x * fs); no hard-coded rate or resampling. clean_ecg passes fs to nk.ecg_clean, find_rpeaks passes it to FastNVG.
amplitude_units: not stated
preprocessing: none inside find_waves; README says cleaning is required before delineation and offers .clean_ecg() (wraps nk.ecg_clean, needs neurokit2). R peaks must be supplied (any detector) or computed with .find_rpeaks() (FastNVG, needs vg-beat-detectors).
output_format: dict of wave name -> np.ndarray[int] sample indices (multilead: dict of wave -> list per lead); include_nodetections=True pads missing waves with None
features: p_offset; p_onset; p_peak; q_peak; qrs_offset; qrs_onset; r_peak; s_peak; t_offset; t_onset; t_peak

name: PQRSTann
runtime_deps: numpy>=2.3, scipy>=1.16, wfdb>=4.3; 0.1.0 wheel also imports pyedflib at module level without declaring it
method: Python re-implementation of PhysioNet ECGPUWAVE: Pan-Tompkins R peaks, then derivative (1 - z^-6) and low-pass filtered derivatives with threshold rules for QRS, T and P boundaries; search windows scaled by running mean RR.
shape: file path only at the public API: .dat (WFDB, read with wfdb.rdrecord on the path without extension), .edf (pyedflib), .csv (n_samples x n_channels, comma separated); one channel selected by `channel`
fs_supported: any (README: 'Works with signals of any sampling frequency'); taken from the WFDB/EDF header, required only for CSV
fs_notes: Search windows are converted ms->samples with fs, and the P-wave 12 Hz Butterworth LPF uses fs, but the Pan-Tompkins band-pass (integer-coefficient LPF/HPF difference equations of the 200 Hz design), the QRS differentiator 1 - z^-6 and the T-wave LPF (1 - z^-8)/(1 - z^-1) have fixed sample-domain taps, so their effective cut-offs scale with fs. Only the integration window comments the 200 Hz origin.
amplitude_units: physical units from file (wfdb p_signal / EDF); CSV as given
preprocessing: internal filters only (Pan-Tompkins band-pass, derivative, P/T low-pass); no baseline-wander removal step stated
output_format: tuple (signal, fs, structured np.ndarray with fields p_on, p_pk, p_off, qrs_on, qrs_pk, qrs_off, t_on, t_pk, t_off; NaN when missing); optional WFDB annotation file '<record>.pqrst' or '<record>.pqrst.csv'
features: heart_rate; p_offset; p_onset; p_peak; qrs_offset; qrs_onset; r_peak; t_offset; t_onset; t_peak

preprocessing: Preprocessing(signal, fs).notch(n_freq=50|60) and .bpfilt() (0.67-100 Hz); bSQI quality index
output_format: fiducials: dict lead_index -> dict of 9 np.ndarray sample indices; biomarkers: dict lead_index -> dict name -> per-beat np.ndarray (ms or signal units), plus statistics dict lead -> name -> {mean, median, min, max, iqr, std}

method: Butterworth band-pass 0.5-30 Hz (zero phase), Haar stationary wavelet transform (level ceil(log2(fs/2/30))) forward and time-reversed, adaptive thresholding for QRS regions, R/Q/S localisation per lead, multi-lead R-peak and beat synchronisation; QRS on/offset placed 25 ms before Q / after S.

Also wraps classical R-peak detectors (wfdb XQRS/GQRS and biosppy hamilton/ssf/christov/engzee/gamboa) and a PhysioNet-edr port.

fs_notes: ECG_UNET / ECG_SUBTRACT_UNET / ECG_SEQ_LAB_NET model configs set fs = 500 (model_configs/*.py); LUDBTrainCfg.fs = 500 (LUDB native rate). No internal resampling in the model forward pass - caller must resample (torch_ecg.preprocessors.Resample exists). adjust_cnn_filter_lengths(config, fs) rescales kernel sizes for other fs.

name: ECGdeli

method: Filtering (baseline removal, high/low-pass, notch, isoline correction) followed by wavelet / filter-bank QRS detection, multi-lead beat synchronisation (voting), and rule-based P and T wave delineation; helper scripts derive interval and amplitude features from the fiducial point table (FPT).

amplitude_units: mV (amplitude features are raw signal values)
preprocessing: separate functions in Filtering/: ECG_Baseline_Removal, ECG_High_Low_Filter, Notch_Filter, Isoline_Correction (used by the example before annotation)
